applicant.name: Mag. Elisabeth Prinz
applicant.organisation: Provincial health fund, department for planning

purpose: Policy-making: comparing the regional heart failure burden.
question: How many patients with heart failure are there per 1,000 patients in each region?
definitions: Heart failure = any condition with an ICD-10 code starting with I50.
The population of a region is all patients whose record has that region.
Report per region: heart failure patients per 1,000 patients, one decimal.
